table.title: Table {{label}}
table.pendingHere: Waiting to sync. The kitchen cannot see this yet.
table.offlineNote: Offline. This is saved on the tablet and sent when the connection returns.

warn.upcoming: This table is booked at {{time}}. You can seat it anyway.
warn.freeBy: You can seat it, but the table must be free by {{time}}.
warn.longNext: The next booking is at {{time}}. Ask whether to bring the bill.
warn.longPromised: They said they would leave by {{time}}.

free.note: The tab stays open and moves to "needs resolving" if anything is owed.
free.title: Free table {{label}}?
free.owed: {{amount}} is still unpaid. The tab stays open and moves to “Needs resolving”.

late.title: Nobody has arrived
late.noBookingId: This tablet does not know which booking that is. Refresh the floor.

release.difference: “They didn't come” goes on the diner's record. “They let us know they won't come” does not.
release.needsOnline: Releasing a booking needs a connection.
release.cancelledTitle: They let us know they won't come

affected.title: Bookings on this table
affected.body: The table is out of service. These people need a phone call — nothing is cancelled automatically.

table.noTab: No tab is open on this table yet.
table.noTabWhy: Orders go on a tab. A guest opens one by scanning the code on the table, or you can start one here for a party that will not scan.
table.startTabNeedsOnline: Starting a tab needs a connection.
table.close: Close and go back to the floor
table.billAsked_one: Asked for the bill in the app {{count}} min ago.
table.billAsked_other: Asked for the bill in the app {{count}} min ago.

held.title: Nobody has arrived.
held.body: Reserved {{time}} · {{late}}. The table is kept until you seat them or release the booking.
held.kept: Held for a party on its way. Seat them when they arrive, or release the hold.

floor.title: Floor
floor.error: We could not load the floor. Try again.
floor.noBranch: Your account has no branch assigned, so there is no floor to show.

notice.race: Table {{label}} was taken by someone else just now.
notice.raceNamed: Table {{label}} was seated by {{name}} just now.
notice.freedWithBalance: Table {{label}} freed. {{amount}} is still owed — it is in "needs resolving".
notice.seatedOverBooking: Seated. Table {{label}} still has a booking coming.
notice.releasedNoShow: Table {{label}}'s booking was released as a no-show.
notice.releasedCancelled: Table {{label}}'s booking was released. It does not count against them.
notice.tabStarted: Tab started on table {{label}}. You can take the order now.
notice.tabNotSeated: Nobody is seated at table {{label}} yet. Seat the party first, then start the tab.
notice.startTabFailed: The tab did not open. Try again.

acted.held: Table {{label}} is held for the late party

notice.releaseNotDue: Table {{label}} · not due until {{time}}. Nothing was released.

unresolved.title: Needs resolving
unresolved.body: The tab is still open. Take the money, then close it.

orders.title: Incoming orders
orders.unreachable: The order queue could not be read. That is not the same as no orders waiting.
orders.awaitingWaiter: Waiting for a waiter to send it to the kitchen.

calls.title: Waiting for a waiter
calls.unreachable: The calls could not be read.

seating.title: Waiting to be seated
seating.todo: Pending seat requests arrive with the seating flow.

approvals.title: Bookings to approve
approvals.empty: No bookings are waiting for an answer.
approvals.unreachable: The bookings waiting for an answer could not be read. That is not the same as none waiting.

because.earlierGuestConsent: The guest before can't be asked in the app — call them

approvals.timeUp: Time is up. The guest is being told the venue could not confirm.
approvals.reasonHint: Kept with the booking. The guest does not see it.
approvals.approvedNotice: Approved: table {{label}} at {{time}}. The guest has been told.
approvals.approvedNoticeOn: Approved: table {{label}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. The guest has been told.
approvals.declinedNotice: Declined: table {{label}} at {{time}}. The guest has been told.
approvals.declinedNoticeOn: Declined: table {{label}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. The guest has been told.
approvals.doneApproved: Approved. The guest has been told.
approvals.doneDeclined: Declined. The guest has been told.
approvals.tooLate: Too late: the time to answer ran out, and the guest has been told the venue could not confirm.
approvals.failed: That did not go through. Try again.
approvals.offline: No connection: the answer was not sent.
approvals.arrived_one: New booking request: table {{label}} at {{time}}, {{count}} guest.
approvals.arrived_other: New booking request: table {{label}} at {{time}}, {{count}} guests.
approvals.arrivedOn_one: New booking request: table {{label}} on {{date}} at {{time}}, {{count}} guest.
approvals.arrivedOn_other: New booking request: table {{label}} on {{date}} at {{time}}, {{count}} guests.
approvals.askBefore: Ask {{name}} whether the table will be free by {{time}}
approvals.awaitingEarlierGuest: The guest before is answering this in the app. It is decided when they do, or declined if they do not.

conflicts.title: Needs a decision
conflicts.subtitle: These could not be applied. Nothing here resolves on its own.

applyAnyway.outOfService: Mark it out of service anyway

conflicts.applyAnywayNote: “Send it anyway” resends without checking the table's state.

reason.refused: The server would not accept it from the table's current state.

status.occupied: occupied and has an open tab

head.changedBack: Table {{label}} is {{state}} again, but it has been used since
head.unknown: Table {{label}}'s state could not be read

order.title: Order · table {{label}}
order.menuOffline: The menu has not been loaded on this tablet yet, and it cannot be fetched without a connection.
order.noTab: No tab is open on this table yet.
order.noTabWhy: Start a tab from the table first. A guest can scan the code on the table, or you can start one for them.
order.offline: Offline · the order will be kept
order.emptyDraft: Tap a dish to add it.
order.whoExplained: Shared dishes are split across everyone at the table. A personal one goes only to the person picked.
order.sentBody: The kitchen can see it. Table {{label}} · {{time}}
order.sendingBody: The kitchen sees it as soon as it arrives.
order.savedBody: No connection. The order is on the tablet and reaches the kitchen when the connection returns. The kitchen cannot see it yet.

refused.guestUnavailable: A guest named on it is no longer on the tab, or has not been let on yet. Nothing was sent.
refused.soldOut: {{name}} has sold out. Nothing was sent.
refused.notAccepting: This tab takes no more orders. Nothing was sent.
refused.other: The server did not take this order. Nothing was sent.

guest.notOnTab: {{name}} is not on this tab. Nothing was sent.
guest.pending: {{name}} has not been let on yet. Nothing was sent.
guest.removed: {{name}} was taken off the tab. Nothing was sent.

tab.closing: The bill has been asked for, so nothing new goes on. Nothing was sent.
tab.closed: This tab is paid and closed, and takes no more orders. Nothing was sent.
tab.abandoned: This tab was written off, and takes no more orders. Nothing was sent.

order.guestGone: {{name}} is no longer on the tab.

tab.title: Tab · table {{label}}
tab.none: No tab is open on this table.
tab.closedNote: This tab is closed. The table stays occupied until someone frees it.
tab.cashOffline: Cash cannot be recorded offline. Take the money and record it when the connection returns.
tab.abandonReason: Written off from the floor screen
tab.offlineUnknown: This table has a tab, but its bill cannot be read without a connection. Do not open a second one.
tab.tips: Tips taken: {{amount}} · on top of the bill
tab.closingNote: The bill has been asked for. No new items go on.
tab.linesUnknown: The items on this tab could not be read. That is not the same as nothing being ordered.
tab.noPeople: Nobody has joined this tab yet.
tab.sharesStaffBlind: Who owes what shows on the guests’ phones only. The tablet sees the whole.
tab.voidWhy: What happened? The guest sees this reason on their phone.
tab.compSeen: The guest sees the reason on their phone. It goes in the report under your name.
tab.markUnpaidWarn: {{amount}} will be recorded as a loss and nobody will be asked to pay it. This cannot be undone.
tab.managerOnly: Discounts and unpaid bills: the manager

notice.voided: {{name}} · voided, the guest sees the reason
notice.markedUnpaid: {{amount}} recorded as a loss · the tab is closed
notice.lineAlreadyPaid: This tab has been paid against, so a line cannot be voided now. Nothing changed.
notice.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed.

tab.voidAfterPayment: This tab has been paid against, so a line cannot be voided now.

cash.title: Take cash
cash.notAReceipt: This records the payment in Yalla. The venue's own cash register still issues the receipt.
cash.failed: We could not record that payment. Nothing was taken.
cash.exceeds: {{requested}} is more than this tab owes. {{remaining}} is left on it. Nothing was recorded.
cash.heading: Cash · table {{label}}
cash.over: More than is owed. Change: {{change}}. If the rest is a tip, put it in the tip field.
cash.partial: Part payment. {{amount}} will be left after this. The tab stays open.
cash.closedBody: The tab is closed. The table stays occupied until you free it.
cash.unknown: We could not tell whether that payment was recorded. Check the tab before you take it again.

billRequest.wantsWhole: Wants to pay the whole bill: {{amount}}
billRequest.prefilled: Filled in from what the table asked for in the app. Change it if they pay differently.
billRequest.pickTitle: Asked for the bill in the app
billRequest.pickNote: The one you pick fills in Take cash.
billRequest.noneBody: Take cash starts from the balance: {{amount}}

connection.pollingHint: Refreshed every few seconds. Refresh to be sure.

install.title: Install this on the tablet
install.body: Open the browser menu and choose Install. It then opens straight to the floor, and starts without a network.

enrol.title: Set this tablet up
enrol.body: A manager generates a one-time code in the console. Type it here, once. After that the tablet remembers its branch and never shows this screen again.
enrol.revoked: This tablet is no longer enrolled. A manager can revoke one from the console — if a device was lost, for instance. Ask for a new code.
enrol.deviceNameWhy: This is the name a manager picks it out by in the device list.
enrol.codeSpent: That code has already been used. Ask for a new one — a code works exactly once.
enrol.codeWrong: That code was not recognised. Check it and type it again.
enrol.offline: No connection. Setting up needs the server.
enrol.failed: Could not set this device up.

pin.lockedByIdle: The tablet locked itself after a quiet spell. Your work is still here.
pin.sessionEnded: Your shift session ended. Tap your PIN again.
pin.rosterFailed: Could not load the staff list. Showing people who signed in here before.
pin.staffIdWhy: Ask a manager: it is in the console, under Staff → Edit → Copy staff ID. Once the list loads, your name appears here instead.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. This PIN is locked.
pin.askManager: A manager can unlock it in the console: Staff → Unlock PIN.
pin.offline: No connection. Signing in needs the server.
pin.foot: Your PIN is personal and never shown. Forgot it? A manager can set a new one from the console.

session.switchPerson: {{name}} · tap to sign out and hand the tablet over

calls.ackNotice: Table {{label}} · the guest can see you are coming
calls.ackQueued: Table {{label}} · saved; the guest sees it when the connection returns
